Python floating point: predict, compare, transfer

Static sequence

  1. Predict: Does 0.1 + 0.2 equal 0.3 exactly?
  2. Inspect: A common IEEE-754 binary floating-point evaluation produces 0.30000000000000004.
  3. Explain: Decimal 0.1 and 0.2 cannot be represented exactly as finite binary fractions, so the computer adds nearby rounded values and rounds the sum.
  4. Transfer: Predict the evaluated result of 0.7 + 0.1 before checking it.
  5. Reflect: Explain the discrepancy in your own words.
  6. Export the local receipt only if you choose to share it with a tutor.
